name: Arcane
description: Modern web interface to manage Docker containers, images and Compose projects.

privileges.explain: Arcane mounts the Docker socket. Anyone who can sign in to Arcane controls every container on this PC and, through Docker, the PC itself.

security: Change the default administrator password on first sign-in (see Arcane's documentation).
Never publish it without Cloudflare Access in front of its own login.

notes: Browser-only administration: ForwardAuth adds a second sign-in in front of its own.
Controls Docker: keep it local or behind authentication; never public without it.

limitations: Needs the Docker socket (full control of Docker on this PC).

update.notes: Back up the data volume before updating; downgrades are blocked by Arcane.

exposure.warning: Arcane controls Docker on this PC: publish it only behind Cloudflare Access.

choiceGroup.note: Recommended for everyday container, image, network and Compose management. Optional: the manager does not need it. Portainer is the alternative; one of the two is enough.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, its web interface, network isolation, stack on disk, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
